checks.name: All mandatory register fields are complete (Annex A)
Display code is unique and built from current reference data; no retired function code
Parent link exists and the parent is approved
Document type matches layer, and content matches type (no tools or steps in a Policy)
Domain is from reference data and the approval route resolves to role holders
First Pass and Final Approval resolve to different roles and different people
Every role named in the text exists in the Role Register

At programme extraction, each control has requirement, risk statement, accountable and executing roles, trigger or frequency, evidence Record ID, failure route and exception route. System links, freshness periods, machine evidence sources and Document Register links are loading tasks
Every evidence reference resolves to a Record ID in the Catalogue, to declared evidence at source, or to a logged Record admission request within its decision time
Every control carries a risk statement (what could happen, why, consequence), and no internal Risk Register or risk ID is referenced
No control duplicates an existing Control ID or restates it with a changed requirement, role, evidence or trigger
No vague qualifier is used in a requirement, trigger or step
No programme commentary, predecessor citation, pending list, drafting note or individual's name appears in controlled text
Normative words are used correctly and abbreviations are defined
Required sections (7.3) are present; table of contents present over five pages
Layer 4 steps each name a responsible role, and handoffs name both roles
Automated steps declare their evidence output and source system
No local Record Type, retention, custodian or disposition is written in the text
Similar existing documents or controls are shown to the author before a new record is created
A version increment carries a change summary, and a material change carries a version increment
For operational documents, stakeholder consultation is recorded; for company position documents, the designation is confirmed by the Final Approver; sensitisation is recorded where required
Every QMS or ISMS scoped control has a non-blank per-control Standard mapping (ISO 9001 clause and/or ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A control, and NDPA section where relevant)
File name equals title and carries no status, version or date text
The AI Involvement field is completed, and laws and standards cited are at their current version
